original.target_description: Blair et al. (2007), Affective Stroop study; ambiguous behavioral/fMRI target at PDF page 5, printed page 434.

notes: Assigned field only: es_value_o. Primary title, authors, journal and DOI match the supplied reference. The locator p. 5 (printed p. 434) and the paper-title description identify multiple candidate behavioral and fMRI tests, without specifying outcome, contrast or brain region. Candidates on that page include behavioral positive-versus-neutral emotion F(1,21) = 4.57, p < 0.05; task F(1,21) = 25.75, p < 0.001; emotion-by-task F < 1; negative-stimulus middle-frontal follow-ups F(1,21) = 4.58, p < 0.05, and F(1,21) = 4.69, p < 0.05; negative-versus-neutral during incongruent trials F(1,21) = 8.18, p < 0.01, with 3.38, n.s. and 2.95 for congruent and view trials respectively. Table 2 on the same page prints many regional F-values, including interaction F = 6.93. Printed p. 433 also gives negative-versus-neutral behavioral F(1,21) = 13.12, p < 0.005, task F(1,21) = 13.83, p < 0.005 and interaction F = 2.25, p = 0.149. No unique test can be assigned from the neutral locator. These are printed F statistics, not d; no d conversion performed. Candidate evidence is retained only in notes/disposition; no statistic selected. No PDF path supplied, so rendering unavailable. Replication, N, p and reported-success entries are unassigned placeholders.
